mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.main.mapper.MainMapper.selectNoticeList */ notice_no , notice_title , DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as reg_dt FROM seinfo_notice WHERE notice_type = 'N' ORDER BY notice_no DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.main.mapper.MainMapper.selectUsrInfo */ faq_type , faq_no , faq_question , CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(faq_answer) > 110 THEN LEFT(faq_answer, 110)||'...' ELSE faq_answer END AS faq_answer FROM seinfo_faq ORDER BY faq_no ASC LIMIT 2
